# Synthetic media fixtures

Created for this project using FFmpeg, with no personal information or real workplace footage. Landscape (640x360) and portrait (180x320) are four-second, 10 fps H.264/yuv420p MP4 videos of plain geometric shapes. `audio.wav` is a silent PCM audio-only rejection fixture. Fixture files are development/test inputs, never embedded in the distributed HTML. They can be reused under this repository's MIT license.

These small fixtures demonstrate decoding and seeking only. Size-limit unit tests are not evidence of real multi-gigabyte playback. No large-file or real-device mobile claim is made.
